parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked for any execution of shell commands or system calls after reading from stdin. The code only reads input into a buffer (line 58) and then sends that buffer over the network using sendto (line 64). No exec, system, popen, or similar function is invoked, so there is no path from untrusted input to an OS command execution. The sink is sendto, which merely transmits data; it does not interpret or execute it. Therefore the claim of OS Command Injection is unfounded.
